tagline: Attach video context to email workflows and never lose recorded insights in your inbox
metaTitle: Gmail + Loom Integration: Loom Videos Summarized by Email
metaDescription: Summarize Loom videos you receive by email into text and get recording reminders from threads. GAIA shares Looms externally. See the setup steps.
intro:
Recorded walkthroughs and email threads often carry different parts of the same conversation. A client emails a question that would take paragraphs to answer in text; a Loom video would explain it in two minutes. A team member records a walkthrough of a problem; the recipients need to email it to external stakeholders with proper context. These two async communication formats rarely work together smoothly.

GAIA connects Gmail and Loom to make video and email work as a unified async communication layer. When you receive an email that warrants a video response, GAIA can prompt you to record a video and automatically send the link with a transcript excerpt in reply. When a recording is shared with you, GAIA can generate a text summary and file it with the relevant email thread so the content is searchable.

For customer success teams, sales professionals, and async-first remote teams, this integration means video context is never isolated from the email conversations that surround it—and you spend less time deciding whether to type a long reply or record a video.

useCases.title: Trigger Loom recording reminders from email threads
useCases.description: When an email arrives that GAIA identifies as better suited for a video response—complex explanations, product demos, onboarding walkthroughs—GAIA flags it and prompts you to record, then handles sending the link as a reply.

useCases.title: Summarize videos received by email into text
useCases.description: When someone emails you a link to a recording, GAIA generates a text summary of the video content using the recording's transcript and adds it to the email thread as a note, so you can reference key points without rewatching.

useCases.title: Share recordings with external email recipients
useCases.description: When a recording is created internally for client communication, GAIA drafts the outbound email with the video link, a text summary excerpt, and the relevant context from previous email threads, ready to send with one click.

useCases.title: Archive Loom content into searchable email threads
useCases.description: GAIA takes recordings shared across various channels and files their transcript summaries into the relevant email thread, creating a single searchable record of both written and video communication.

useCases.title: Automated follow-up after video views
useCases.description: When GAIA detects that a recipient has viewed your recording (via view notifications), it can draft a follow-up email asking for questions or next steps, keeping the conversation moving.

howItWorks.step: Connect Gmail and Loom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate both accounts in GAIA's settings. GAIA accesses your recording library and inbox to coordinate content between them.
Tell GAIA when to suggest video responses, how to format summaries in email, and how to handle incoming video links. You set the rules in plain language.

howItWorks.step: Video and email work together automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA handles the translation between video content and email threads, keeping async communication cohesive and making sure video context is never siloed from the conversations that need it.

faqs.question: Does GAIA transcribe videos itself or use Loom's built-in transcript?
faqs.answer: It uses the native transcript where available (Business plans and above include auto-transcription). For recordings without transcripts, it can summarize based on the video title, description, and any captions.

faqs.question: Can GAIA send a video reply directly from Gmail?
faqs.answer: It facilitates the workflow: it identifies the email needing a video response, prompts you to record, and then sends the link as an email reply once you've completed the recording. The recording step itself happens in the recording app.

faqs.question: Does this work for shared workspaces used by a team?
faqs.answer: Yes. It can be configured to monitor shared workspaces and route video summaries or notifications to the appropriate team member's inbox based on the video's assigned owner or topic.

faqs.question: Can GAIA track whether email recipients have watched the video?
faqs.answer: If view analytics are available through the video service's API, it can monitor view status and trigger follow-up email drafts when a recipient has watched the recording. This depends on your plan's analytics capabilities.
